supersession_policy: The v1 protocol and all existing artifacts remain immutable historical records. Only experiments started after this amendment use v2 for pass/fail.
objective: Complete one real-data main forecasting experiment for a fixed SphereDyn seed and its final SphereTTC prediction. GraphCast and all other baselines are descriptive references only.

required_outputs: final SphereDyn plus SphereTTC forecast cache
primary macro nRMSE for both caches
main-result manifest with data, code, checkpoint, and device provenance

graphcast_policy.reporting_rule: GraphCast may be included in the main table for context, but no comparison with GraphCast changes PASS or FAIL.

evaluation_scope.rule: Use one predeclared complete evaluation period supported by the frozen main pipeline; do not select dates after reading main-result metrics.
evaluation_scope.development_evidence_policy: Existing 2018--2019 results remain development evidence and may support configuration selection, but they are not relabeled as blind evidence.
evaluation_scope.prospective_2023_policy: A 2023 run is optional under v2. If run, it must remain a single frozen main prediction run and must not trigger tuning or auxiliary experiments.

stop_rule: Stop when the single-seed main prediction gate passes. Do not schedule multiseed, ablation, robustness, cross-backbone, or extra diagnostic jobs solely for goal completion.
